provenance.note: All sections recomputed by this script except the flagged carried-over values. Donor-edge offsets are fit on train genes only (see tiered_model_and_bayesian_lr/fitted_arch_offsets). Feature matrix carries real CADD values for validation and test variants (19,014 of 60,521 scored); every train row still carries the -1.0 sentinel, so the fitted CADD coefficient was never fit against varying CADD values.

consequence_only_baseline.method: one-hot mane_class logistic regression (C=1.0, class_weight=balanced), fit on 61 train genes, evaluated on 24 test genes; no exon, AlphaMissense, CADD, or SpliceAI features
consequence_only_baseline.within_missense_note: 0.5 by construction: consequence is constant within missense, so the baseline cannot rank missense variants

fitted_arch_offsets.method: logistic regression on train internal missense only; m1_logit held fixed as offset (coef 1.0); L2 penalty 0.5*||w||^2; balanced class weights

tiered_model_and_bayesian_lr.bayesian_lr_method: LR(cell) = P(cell|P/LP) / P(cell|B/LB) on resolved internal missense variants, no smoothing; 95% CI on the log scale. Research-only; not a clinical classification.

donor_edge_lr.definition: internal resolved missense, d_donor_edge <= 3 bp, exon_len <= 400 bp, expr_backup_skips == 0

regime_ii_lr.definition: resolved variants with mane_sev_v46 <= 1 and alt_max_sev_v46 == 4, among all resolved variants in the 587k table

tiered_model_and_bayesian_lr.vus_file_note: results/vus_bayesian_stratification.tsv carries per-variant LRs with CIs and no ACMG labels; see results/vus_bayesian_stratification_NOTE.md.
